# eyetest.co.uk

> eyetest.co.uk is a UK eye test comparison site. It helps people find opticians near them, compare prices and services, and book direct with the optician, showing appointment availability where it can. It covers 97 UK cities and towns. Prices and practice details are checked against each optician's own website; information on each page shows when it was last checked.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/): Find opticians near you and book direct
- [Find Opticians](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find): Find opticians near your location
- [Eye Tests](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-tests): Browse all types of eye tests available in the UK
- [Eye Health](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health): Eye health conditions, guides, and advice
- [Opticians](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/opticians): Compare UK optician brands and chains
- [UK Locations](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/locations): Find eye tests in 97 UK cities and towns
- [At-Home Eye Tests](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/at-home-eye-tests): Who qualifies for an NHS eye test at home, and the main home visit providers listed alphabetically (checked November 2026)
- [Offers](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/offers): Current offers from 9 UK opticians, each checked against the optician's own offers page on 11 November 2026
- [Get Listed](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/get-listed): Optician sign-up for the platform
- [About Us](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/about): About eyetest.co.uk

## Optician Brands by Town
Each brand has a page for each of the 97 towns, at https://www.eyetest.co.uk/opticians/{brand}/{town} (for example [Boots Opticians Manchester](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/opticians/boots-opticians/manchester) or [Specsavers Salisbury](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/opticians/specsavers/salisbury)). Where the brand has a practice in and around the town, the page lists the real practices with address, phone and a link to book direct, taken from the optician's own website or booking system (checked 11 November 2026). Where it does not, the page says so and lists the nearest towns with that brand and the other opticians in the town.

## Eye Surgery
- [Eye Surgery Hub](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery): NHS and private eye surgery providers listed alphabetically; no provider is ranked or recommended
- [Cataract Surgery](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/cataracts): Cataract surgery information, NHS and private options, costs, and recovery
- [Glaucoma Surgery](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/glaucoma-surgery): Glaucoma surgery options including SLT laser and trabeculectomy
- [Laser Eye Surgery](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/laser-eye-surgery): LASIK, LASEK and SMILE, when the NHS may fund it, and checked prices from Optical Express, Optimax, Optegra and Moorfields Private
- [Macular Degeneration Treatment](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/macular-degeneration): AMD treatment including anti-VEGF injections
- [Retinal Detachment Surgery](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/retinal-detachment): Emergency retinal detachment repair
- [Eyelid Surgery](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/eyelid-surgery): Blepharoplasty, ptosis repair, and eyelid conditions
- [Corneal Conditions](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/corneal-conditions): Keratoconus treatment, corneal cross-linking, and transplants
- [Diabetic Eye Disease](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/diabetic-eye-disease): Diabetic retinopathy treatment and management
- [Find a Surgeon](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/search): Search for eye surgery clinics by postcode
- [Surgery Enquiry](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-surgery/enquiry): Submit an eye surgery enquiry

- [Floaters and Flashes](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/floaters-and-flashes)

- [Colour Blindness (Colour Vision Deficiency)](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/colour-blindness)
- [Strabismus (Squint)](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/strabismus)
- [Red Eye](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/red-eye): Common causes from the NHS, self-care, and when a red eye needs urgent help or A&E
- [Stye](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/stye): Warm compress treatment, do not burst it, when to see a GP
- [Chalazion](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/chalazion): Harmless eyelid cyst from a blocked oil gland, treatment, and stye vs chalazion
- [Eye Twitching](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/eye-twitching): Common triggers, self-help, and see a GP if it lasts more than 2 weeks
- [Uveitis](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/uveitis): Inflammation inside the eye that needs urgent advice
- [Swollen Eyelid](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/swollen-eyelid): Common causes and when swelling is urgent
- [Lazy Eye](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/lazy-eye): Signs in children, best treated before age 7, glasses, patches and drops
- [Detached Retina](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/retinal-detachment): Warning signs that need NHS 111 straight away, surgery and recovery
- [Watery Eyes](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/watery-eyes): Common causes and when to see a GP
- [Double Vision](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/conditions/double-vision): Always get it checked; urgent signs and the DVLA rule

- [Eye Test Cost UK](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/eye-test-cost): Published eye test prices at Specsavers (£20 to £25), Asda (£24), Boots (from £29.95), Vision Express (£30 with OCT) and M&S (£40 with OCT), checked November 2026
- [Free Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/free-eye-test): Who gets a free NHS eye test in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, proof to bring, vouchers and time-limited optician offers
- [Cheap Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/cheap-eye-test): Cheapest eye tests near you
- [Private Eye Test Cost](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/private-eye-test-cost): Private eye test costs UK
- [Free Eye Test Over 60](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/free-eye-test-over-60): NHS free tests for over 60s
- [Free Eye Test Children](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/free-eye-test-children): NHS entitlement for children
- [Free Eye Test Diabetes](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/free-eye-test-diabetes): NHS entitlement for people with diabetes
- [Free Eye Test Universal Credit](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/free-eye-test-universal-credit): Free NHS eye test and voucher if take-home pay is £435 or less (£935 with a child element or LCW)
- [NHS Optical Voucher](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/nhs-optical-voucher): England voucher values £42.40 to £233.56 (April 2026), who qualifies and how to use one
- [Same-Day Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/same-day-eye-test): Find last-minute appointments
- [Walk-In Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/walk-in-eye-test): No appointment needed opticians
- [Weekend Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/weekend-eye-test): Saturday and Sunday appointments
- [Emergency Eye Test Near Me](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/emergency-eye-test-near-me): Urgent same-day eye care
- [Online Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/online-eye-test): Can you test your eyes online?
- [Specsavers vs Boots](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/specsavers-vs-boots): Eye test comparison
- [Book an Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/book-eye-test): How to book online or by phone with the main UK opticians and how to book a free NHS test
- [Opticians Near Me](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/opticians-near-me): Find opticians near you by postcode or town, with links to every town page
- [What Happens During an Eye Test?](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/articles/what-happens-during-an-eye-test): Step-by-step UK guide from College of Optometrists and NHS sources: what is checked, around 20 to 30 minutes, what to bring, and your right to your prescription
- [Contact Lenses: A UK Guide](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/articles/contact-lenses): Types of lens, who can fit them, safe wear on water and sleep, check-ups and UK rules on buying lenses online, from College of Optometrists, NHS Wales and GOC sources
- [Do Blue Light Glasses Work?](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/articles/blue-light-glasses): What the College of Optometrists and a 2023 Cochrane review found on eye strain, sleep and eye health, and what helps with screen discomfort
- [Varifocals: A UK Guide](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/articles/varifocals): How varifocals compare with bifocals and reading glasses, who they suit, tips for getting used to them and NHS voucher help
- [Optician vs Optometrist](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/articles/optician-vs-optometrist): Who does what in UK eye care, from optometrists and dispensing opticians to ophthalmologists and orthoptists, and how to check the GOC register
- [Laser Eye Surgery Cost in the UK](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/articles/laser-eye-surgery-cost): Laser eye surgery prices from Optical Express, Optimax, Optegra and Moorfields Private, checked on each clinic's own website, with the Royal College of Ophthalmologists' checks before booking
- [How Long Does an Eye Test Take?](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/how-long-does-eye-test-take): UK appointment guide
- [How Often Should You Have an Eye Test?](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/eye-health/guides/how-often-should-you-have-an-eye-test): NHS guidance is every 2 years or more often if your optometrist advises; diabetic eye screening every 1 or 2 years; who gets free NHS tests
- [Do I Need an Eye Test?](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/do-i-need-an-eye-test): Signs you should book one
- [Failed the Driving Test Eyesight Check](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/eye-test-failed-driving): Per GOV.UK you fail, the DVLA is told and your licence is revoked; reapply and pass a DVSA eyesight test
- [OCT Scan Cost UK](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/oct-scan-cost): How much is an OCT eye scan
- [Contact Lens Eye Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/contact-lens-eye-test): Fitting, check-ups and cost
- [Glaucoma Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/glaucoma-test): What it involves, cost and where to get tested
- [Colour Blind Test](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/colour-blind-test): How to get a colour vision check at a UK optician (not part of the routine NHS eye test, but you can ask for it), the Ishihara and colour arrangement tests, signs in children, and DVLA rules

- [Headaches and Vision](https://www.eyetest.co.uk/find/headaches-and-vision): Could your eyes be the cause?
